subject: Q2 Finance & Billing: headcount approvals and proposed offers
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: 3 hires for Finance & Billing Q2 headcount

Hi team,

I'm requesting approval to open and fund three roles in Q2 for Finance & Billing to support ramp and reduce run-rate risk as usage continues to grow:

1) FP&A Manager (team lead) — 1 headcount
   - Justification: lead monthly forecasting cadence, own variance analysis + executive reporting.
   - Comp band (base): $120,000 - $160,000 (target midpoint $140k).

2) RevOps Analyst — 1 headcount
   - Justification: improve billing telemetry, automate usage->invoice reconciliation for hosted customers.
   - Comp band (base): $85,000 - $110,000 (midpoint $97.5k).

3) Billing Ops Specialist — 1 headcount (hands-on billing & collections)
   - Justification: reduce invoice exceptions and DSO; necessary as new Dedicated customers onboard.
   - Comp band (base): $80,000 - $105,000 (midpoint $92.5k).

Total annual fully-loaded cost (base + benefits + recruiting) estimated at ~ $435k - $475k depending on bands and hiring timing. I've attached the HC request form and the comp bands file for reference.

Proposed phasing:
- Open Billing Ops immediately (candidate in pipeline: Aisha Patel, Harper Talent). Aim to extend offer week of 2/16.
- RevOps and FP&A to follow; FP&A hire to start EOM Q2 to align with planning cycle.

Approvals requested:
- Headcount funding confirmation from Finance (Neha)
- Final comp band sign-off (Neha + People Ops)
- Legal review for offer template / contractor vs employee (Rishi)

Attachments: 2026_Q2_HC_Request_Form.pdf, Comp_Bands_Finance_2026.xlsx

Next steps: if we have approvals, I'll ask Harper to prepare the draft offer (comp + sign-on) and route to People Ops/Legal.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: 3 hires for Finance & Billing Q2 headcount

Thanks Marissa — quick read and a few notes:

- Approve opening all three roles headcount-wise. Please proceed with requisitions.
- Comp band change request: reduce Billing Ops max from $105k to $100k (we should keep downward pressure; we can still make competitive offers at the midpoint + sign-on).
- Please include recruiting fees and onboarding ramp cost in the run-rate (I estimate $8k recruiting + $4k onboarding per hire).
- For FP&A Manager, consider targeting an external candidate at the lower-mid band and pairing with a modest equity grant instead of higher base.

Action items for Marissa: route final offer letters to People Ops for comp calibration (Monica) and to Legal (Rishi) prior to sending. Also drop the updated run-rate numbers into the finance forecast model and share the impact to 2026 Opex.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: 3 hires for Finance & Billing Q2 headcount

On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 1:45 PM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Approve opening all three roles headcount-wise.

Agree with Neha. Two quick asks from my side:
1) For Billing Ops (candidate Aisha), can we include a small performance-based sign-on tied to outstanding invoice reduction targets for the first 90 days? That will help align incentives.
2) Please attach the updated run-rate impact for my review — I'll want the monthly P&L deltas to feed into the capacity planning deck.

I'm copying Monica so People Ops can confirm the comp bands and the standard sign-on language. Rishi, please advise if there's any unusual language we need in offers for billing/collections roles.

Attachment: RunRate_Impact_Q2_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Harper Talent Partners <sarah@harpertalent.co>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Draft offer: Billing Ops Specialist — Aisha Patel (candidate)

Sarah / Aisha — thanks again for the fast pipeline work. Below is the draft offer framework we discussed (Marissa to start finalizing once internal approvals are confirmed):

Role: Billing Ops Specialist (full-time)
Manager: Vivek Kulkarni
Start: target 2026-03-02 (flexible)
Base salary: $97,000 per year (within band; midpoint + small adjustment)
Sign-on: $5,000 (one-time, paid in first payroll)
Equity: RSU grant equivalent to 0.02% of company (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff) — subject to standard plan docs
On-target expectations: reduce invoice exception rate by 40% within 90 days; we will set concrete metrics in first-week 30/60/90 plan.
Probation: standard 90-day review

Attachments: Draft_Offer_Aisha_Patel_20260211.docx

Per Neha's note, we've kept comp inside approved band. Vivek proposed linking a portion of sign-on to 90-day performance; happy to structure language to reflect that if you prefer.

Next: Sarah, please confirm candidate acceptance window; once we have verbal acceptance we'll route the official offer through People Ops and Legal for sign-off.

Best,
Marissa
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@harpertalent.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft offer: Billing Ops Specialist — Aisha Patel (candidate)

Hi Marissa / Vivek — quick update from Aisha: she is excited about the role and has asked if we can move the base to $99,000 (from $97k) to account for commute and cost-of-living differences; she'd be flexible on a reduced sign-on if the base is increased.

She would like 3 business days to consider a final written offer. If you prefer to keep base at $97k + $5k sign-on, she'll accept that as well.

On the performance-based sign-on language — Aisha is open to clear, measurable targets. She asked that any metrics be documented and agreed in writing prior to the start date.

Sarah
Harper Talent Partners
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@harpertalent.co>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft offer: Billing Ops Specialist — Aisha Patel (candidate)

Thanks — quick decision: approve extending the offer at $99,000 base with a $3,000 sign-on (net neutral to total comp vs prior plan). Monica — please prepare the formal offer using the attached draft and include the 90-day performance milestones in section 3. Rishi — please review and confirm that the performance-based sign-on language is enforceable and standard.

Marissa
